actions.label: Desk status
actions.description: Check that Desk is ready for this session.
actions.agent: Session-start health check for the resolved desk root. The compact answer has `state` (ready, degraded, admitting or setup_required), `degraded` (why), `fix` (what to do in this session), `search`, `notes` and where the desk is. Retries admission when Desk is not ready. `detail: true` returns the full payload. A hosted Desk (claude.ai, ChatGPT) also returns its instructions, unless `has_instructions: true`; follow them and read the skills they name with desk_skill.

detail.label: Full payload
detail.description: Pass true for the full payload (tens of KB). Omit it for the compact answer.

hasInstructions.label: Has instructions
hasInstructions.description: Hosted Desk only: pass true when an earlier desk_status answer in this conversation already gave you Desk's instructions.

actions.label: Desk doctor
actions.description: Check Desk's runtime, and repair or reindex it when asked.
actions.agent: Use when Desk misbehaves or its runtime needs checking: report whether Desk MCP started in healthy runtime mode; in diagnostic mode, the precise startup failure and offline remediation. `format: "preview"` returns only the local package/process snapshot. `repair: "switch_state_branch"` switches the desk checkout back to its state branch when that is safe. `reindex: true` re-reads the desk into the search engine when search misses what you just wrote. `factory_consent` records the operator's factory contribution answer and returns only that record.

format.label: Format
format.description: preview returns only the local package/process snapshot.

reindex.label: Reindex
reindex.description: Pass true to re-read the desk into this session's search engine and wait until exact-word search is current.

factoryConsent.label: Factory consent
factoryConsent.description: The operator's answer to the factory contribution question; Desk resolves the store and, for yes, the GitHub account.

actions.label: Next improvement
actions.description: Take the next improvement card to work on.
actions.agent: Use when you take on improvement work: take the next improvement card, the open card that waited longest. It claims the card for a limited time and returns it with the `claim_id` and the authority statement. A refusal comes back as `status` (claim_held, cap_reached, none_open, too_many_cards, machine_key_unavailable or noninteractive) with a one-line `meaning`. Optional `session` is the session's UUID.
